description: Add a bottle from a photo, like Add Bottle → photo in the app: the preview identifies it; after the user agrees, AI art is made from the photo (1K) and the bottle is added with it. Free: 5 AI art a day; Pro: unlimited. Two steps: repeat with confirm_token after the user agrees.

confirm_token.description: Omit first: you get a preview (and what it costs). Repeat with identical arguments plus this token after the user agrees.

imageData.description: Base64 JPEG/PNG photo of the bottle (or a data: URL)

style.description: Art style. Free: Elements. Pro: Elements, Dark, Blended, Heritage, Oak, Cheers.

name: add_bottle_from_photo
